Animate this hand-made cut-paper collage picture-book illustration as gentle 2D cut-out stop-motion, like the page come to life. Motion direction: 0 to 4 seconds: a howling wind whips the dark stormy sea into rolling waves and the little empty wooden boat pitches up and down; behind it a gigantic wave, taller than a mountain, rises up out of the sea. 4 to 6 seconds: the giant wave curls over and crashes down onto the little boat, tipping it over. 6 to 8 seconds: the boat is gone beneath the churning white foam and the great wave rolls on, ending exactly on the final frame. The storm clouds drift; the camera stays still.
Style lock: preserve every scissor-cut paper edge, painted brushstroke and paper texture and the flat 2D picture-book cut-paper look of the starting frame; keep every character's face, hair, clothes and colours exactly as in the starting frame; calm, steady camera like a multi-plane animation stand; never 3D, no new characters, no text, captions or watermarks.
